source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
When you [muster your army](vsdata:core-rule/muster-armies), each **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit you add must get one of **KHORNE**, **TZEENTCH**, **NURGLE**, **SLAANESH** or **CHAOS UNDIVIDED**, recorded on your Army Roster, unless it is an **EPIC HERO** or already has one of them.

Whenever a unit that carries one of those keywords gets a weapon ability from a [Dark Pact](vsdata:ability/chaos-space-marines.dark-pacts) and passes the [Leadership test](vsdata:core-rule/leadership-rolls) that follows, it gets the matching ability below for the rest of the phase.

If it got **[[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)**:

- **KHORNE**: its melee attacks score Critical Hits on unmodified [Hit rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) of 5+.
- **TZEENTCH**: its ranged attacks score Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.
- **CHAOS UNDIVIDED**: its attacks can re-roll 1s to Hit.

If it got **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)**:

- **NURGLE**: its ranged attacks score Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.
- **SLAANESH**: its melee attacks score Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.
- **CHAOS UNDIVIDED**: its attacks can re-roll 1s to Hit.
